rāgāṅgāni aṣṭa gāmbhīrī vauhāṭī khaśikā utpalī
gāndhāragati kārañjau iti ekādaśa menire
bhāṣā aṅgāni atha bhāvakrī svabhāvakrī śivakriyaḥ
ojakrī indrakriyaḥ nāgakṛtiḥ dhanyakṛtiḥ tathā
vipāya krīḥ kriyā aṅgāṇi dvādaśa iti jaguḥ budhāḥ
trīṇi upāṅgāni pūrṇāṭaḥ devālaḥ ca guruñjikā
